mentions.name: Resizable Mac calculator app
mentions.description: A calculator app for Mac that can be resized to large sizes, such as half the screen, so it is comfortable to use while working.
mentions.problem: The author can't work with small calculator apps on a Mac.
mentions.source_excerpt: Also working on a calculator app that can be resized to large sizes (think half screen on Mac), because I can’t work with small calculator apps on my Mac.

evidence.value: Also working on a calculator app that can be resized to large sizes (think half screen on Mac), because I can’t work with small calculator apps on my Mac.
